decision.overall: All eight mandatory comparisons must pass; any fail means fail; otherwise any inconclusive means inconclusive

independent_rr: r=1 randomized-response ratio L/d, independent of saved retained response; alternative comparator, not another protected release

learner.decoder: Mechanism-level marginal unbiased decoder only; conditional retained history can bias it
learner.encoding: Fixed manifest category sizes; all declared levels including code zero; no target-dependent preprocessing

margin_justification: Illustrative public research margin; independent service-owner justification pending
public_only: Same learner fitted on 512 disjoint clean labeled auxiliary records; never test truth or randomized training truth

scope.data: Existing public historical categorical matrices; all labels already public
scope.person_household_linkage: Not present in prepared keys; row disjointness only
scope.protected_sampling: none; every repetition is a public benchmark simulation
scope.representation: Four governmental task domains, bounded fixed historical samples; population representativeness not established
scope.source_transformations: Retained historical transformations; hashes do not independently validate reconstruction

simulation.paired_alternatives: Common independent per-repetition integer uniform tickets for the two alternative fresh laws; exact rational probability thresholds
simulation.reference_model: First preregistered replicate, descriptive only; never selected by scores
simulation.retained_history: One persisted public simulated retained RR vector per corpus; repetitions condition on those actual saved responses
simulation.rng: NumPy PCG64; SHA256 domain-separated seed per corpus and purpose; fixed public seed schedule
simulation.stopping: Exactly 4096 repetitions per task; no adaptive increase, favorable seed or cohort selection

acs.period: Pooled 2020-2024 survey years, historical train/test partition
acs.title: ACS income

bts.label_rule: Cancelled == 1 or DepDel15 == 1; fixed historical eligibility requires known labels
bts.task: Flight cancellation or departure delay at least 15 minutes
bts.title: BTS departure disruption

hmda.label_rule: action_taken == 1, with unknown income excluded in the historical fixed roster
hmda.old_label: Historical known-income bins BIN_4 through BIN_7
hmda.task: Recorded loan origination among actions 1 through 5
hmda.title: HMDA loan origination

tlc.label_rule: trip_time > 1800 seconds on the historical finite nonnegative-duration/distance roster
tlc.title: TLC long trip

split.priority: Full SHA256(salt + corpus + colon + key), then key; labels never enter selection
split.train_auxiliary: First 512 and next 512 unique keys within source_panel=train

uncertainty.interpretation: Monte Carlo integration uncertainty on fixed historical public rows and saved retained responses under ideal iid uniform tickets; seeded PCG64 is a reproducible computational approximation, not a mathematical iid proof
uncertainty.mechanism_quantiles: Descriptive 2.5 and 97.5 percentile losses; not confidence intervals
uncertainty.method: Simultaneous two-sided Hoeffding union bound on paired replicate gains in [-1,1]
